question: A 793 m long train is running at 90 km/hr. How long will it take to clear a 782 m long platform completely?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To clear the platform completely, the train must cover its own length + platform length.

Total distance = 793 m + 782 m = 1575 m.

Convert speed to m/s: 90 km/hr = 90 × 1000 ÷ 3600 = 25 m/s.

Time = Total distance ÷ Speed = 1575 ÷ 25 = 63 seconds.

**∴ Answer = 63 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Train length = 793 m, Platform length = 782 m, Speed = 90 km/hr.

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 Train: 793 m Platform: 782 m 
• Total Distance: 1575 m 

**Calculations:**

Total distance = Train length + Platform length = 793 + 782 = 1575 m.

⇒ Speed in m/s = 90 × 1000 ÷ 3600 = 25 m/s.

⇒ Time = Distance ÷ Speed = 1575 ÷ 25 = 63 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 63 seconds.**
